$comment: Three schemas, each name owned by exactly one section (tools/compose/env-check.mjs enforces this). settings and publicBuildConfig are filled from brand.json; privateRuntime names are owned by the brand's generator or pm2 env and never by brand.json. Names only: no values or defaults for secrets live here. A setting reaches the build as its `env` name, written by compose into .env.production from the validated brand.json value (brand.json publicConfig may not set it).

pdp.stockRefreshTrigger.description: When the PDP starts its one live stock refresh. Damned uses qinit (approved 2026-09-26); others stay on qidle.

shop.stockOnLoad.description: Shop page availability on load: manifest only, or one live uncached fail-closed read (owner decision O1).

pdp.bfcacheRefresh.description: Refresh live stock again on a persisted pageshow (owner decision O3; Damned only).

VITE_STORE_SUPPORT_EMAIL.description: Customer support address shown on the site

VITE_STORE_OG_IMAGE.description: Default Open Graph image path or URL

VITE_STORE_STORAGE_NAMESPACE.description: Prefix of the storefront's own browser-storage keys (image-seen cache); default dd keeps the existing key

VITE_STORE_ADDRESS_STREET.description: Postal address, street (enables the address block)

VITE_SHEERID_ENABLED.description: 1 only when the SheerID program is configured

VITE_DEMO_MODE.description: 1 only for the isolated demo build

VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client id (public). Empty (default) = no Google sign-in button and no Google origins in the CSP; must equal the client id the API verifies for this store. Also needs SELLRIGHT_GOOGLE_SIGNIN_HOSTS (runtime): the pinned store's public hosts that may show it

VITE_SR_COMMERCE_FLOW.description: Commerce flow: unset or cart (the cart storefront, src/routes) or license (the license buy-flow, src/platform/license/routes: pricing, one-SKU checkout with legal acceptance, account licenses; brand data src/brand/hosts.json and src/brand/license.json)

notes.BEHIND_CLOUDFLARE: Runtime. 1 only when every request reaches the origin through an edge that overwrites cf-ipcountry (origin locked to Cloudflare). Default unset = the country header is NOT trusted: /api/country answers null and the client falls back. Same opt-in name as the API's.
notes.VITE_IP_COUNTRY_FALLBACK: Build-time and runtime (set both alike). 0/false/off disables the browser fallback lookup of the visitor country at ipapi.co and drops that origin from the CSP connect-src. Default unset = enabled.
notes.VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: Public Turnstile site key. When set (at build and in the runtime environment), the CSP script-src and frame-src also allow https://challenges.cloudflare.com.
